## The claim

P4-28: screen-wide, at least one launched drug is selective for both high-aneuploidy and rhabdomyosarcoma cell lines in PRISM

**Prediction if true.** Over every Launched compound in PRISM Repurposing 24Q2 measurable on at least 3 rhabdomyosarcoma lines and at least 20 lines in each aneuploidy arm, with entry 151's tests unchanged (24Q2 LFC, one-sided Mann-Whitney U, strict median aneuploidy split), at least one drug has Benjamini-Hochberg q < 0.10 in the aneuploidy contrast and q < 0.10 in the rhabdomyosarcoma contrast, BH taken across all eligible Launched compounds in each contrast

**What would refute it.** No eligible Launched compound reaches q < 0.10 in both contrasts
